optionLayouts.columns: multi-column link list: items flow into a 3-column grid from 900px (2 from 600px, 1 below), compact rows, no separators

contentPattern: Text-only news list; each item is a linked article title with a source/date meta line, items separated by horizontal rules. No images.

usage.reuseGuidance: Use for a stacked list of news/article links with a title and a source/date meta line, no thumbnails. One row per news item.
